title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
title_zh: 向前看：自回归视频生成中的未来演化建模

paragraphs.en: 提出未来块预测辅助目标，以更低训练算力提升自回归视频扩散模型的物理合理性。 Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.
paragraphs.zh: 提出未来块预测辅助目标，以更低训练算力提升自回归视频扩散模型的物理合理性。自回归视频扩散模型逐块生成视频，然而生成看似合理的后续内容并不能保证模型真正捕捉了场景的演化方式。 在教师强制下，强时间冗余可能使局部视觉连续性成为当前块去噪的捷径，从而降低了对视觉演化建模的压力。 我们提出未来块预测（FCP），这是一种与教师强制去噪联合优化的辅助目标，它在无法访问中间视觉上下文的情况下预测时间上分离的块。 FCP 直接从训练视频中获取监督信号，无需额外的预训练视觉编码器，并保持自回归推理不变。 我们的方法在总体训练算力预算更低的情况下，实现了优于标准教师强制自回归训练的物理合理性，凸显了未来块监督在建模视觉演化方面的有效性与高效性。 有趣的是，我们的可视化结果表明，FCP 促进了更加结构化的表示空间，这可能对构建自回归世界模型具有价值。
